n74ab30537b.headline: Santander hit by UK mis-selling charge and Brazil slowdown
n74ab30537b.summary: Spanish bank Santander posted a sharp decline in fourth-quarter net profit due to a mis-selling compensation bill in Britain and slowing income in Brazil. The bank showed progress on capital ratios, nudging above 10% under the strictest criteria.
n74ab30537b.why: Santander is a major global bank with significant operations in Europe and Latin America; its financial performance and regulatory issues impact investor confidence and regional banking sectors.
n74ab30537b.why_moved: The mis-selling compensation charge and Brazil income slowdown directly reduce Santander's profitability, triggering investor concerns and share price decline.
